[[Mystic Tribute]] is a [[gift]] used to craft [[Legendary weapon#Generation 2 2|second generation]] legendary weapons, as well as [[legendary trinket]]s. [[Legendary weapon#Generation 1 2|First generation]] legendaries require a [[Gift of Fortune]] instead.
